title: Payments R13: `openagents.com/live`: the Episode 289 flow picture driven by real payments
body:
Design: [central receive and splits, section 7](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/payments/2026-10-02-central-receive-and-splits.md#7-stats-and-the-live-view). Depends on #10195.

Owner: "like that simulation … but I want to see that real movement, like real plugin, real everything."

## Do
- `static/flow.js` (same-origin, canvas) and a page `/live` in `crates/openagents-web`: draw the snapshot topology (positions from the server, the same layout the desktop `routes-future` scene uses), then animate each streamed event: white request out along the path to its node, gold payment back to the hub, gold share on to the author, gold payout to the author's wallet, a ring for bonuses.
- A totals ticker under the map; the time of the last event; no synthetic traffic, ever.
- Match the desktop palette (`REQUEST` white, `PAYMENT` gold in `crates/openagents-desktop/src/route_future.rs`).
- Works at phone width.

## Done when
- With a replayed fixture stream, a screenshot shows dots for each event type, and the page reconnects after the stream drops.


Size: needs a full agent session.

Part of the central payments plan: https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/payments/2026-10-02-central-receive-and-splits.md
